subject: proj-dy
title: (R)PROJ.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in CMBA-29, the second on book p273. (R)PROJ-DY — the reality of projectional dynamics — is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). The diagram uses three prefixed nodes — (R)INFO-INTR (the reality of information interpretation), (C)POST (the concept of postulation), (R)PART (the reality of participation) — staging the structural question of whether real projectional dynamics actually delivers transformation when multi-information is its crossing partner. PROJ-DY → MT-INFO (the crossing). PROJ-DY also branches to SOC-RT (social reality), which leads to DYM-F (dynamic functionalism), and to T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), which branches to (C)POST and (R)INFO-INTR. (R)INFO-INTR leads to MT-RT-SIGN, which branches to (R)PART.
